name: Get calculated attributes
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the calculated attributes for a specific contact, such as transaction count and whether a particular attribute is present. Use the standard contact detail endpoint instead if you only need basic contact information.
preconditions: The contact with the given ID must exist.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

count.description: Number of transactions associated with the contact.

has_attribute.description: Indicates whether the contact has the calculated attribute.
